initiative.title: Field list
initiative.summary: A fast field list that opens anywhere in the workspace for quick inspection, chart creation, and later putting fields on chart axes.

sources.anchor: detailed field list that opens anywhere, quick inspection, add charts, maybe drag fields to charts
PlotManager, FieldMetadata, FieldInspector, ChartActions, useCreateCharts, chartAccessibility at 9435727
field inspector Values view and axis-label open path
field details, popovers, no persistent inspection sidebar, verification widths

claims.text: Open a detailed field list from anywhere, without a summary or data table in the layout.
The list opens quickly and supports quick inspections.
From a field, add a chart and open the field inspector.
A narrow list may let users drag a field onto a chart to swap it in.
Reuse the field inspector and its open path from the axis-label work; do not redesign it.
Opening or using the list never changes the saved layout except when the user adds or edits a chart.
Rows use FieldMetadata and follow the current filter scope.

conflicts.text: UI defaults say not to add a persistent sidebar for temporary inspection; the list stays open as a floating workspace tool.
conflicts.resolution: Byron chose a floating panel that overlays the grid without resizing it and stays open until closed (2026-09-27).

shape.appetite: Three focused passes; the third is optional
shape.problem: Field details and field-first actions exist only inside tables, so a chart-only workspace has no field view.
shape.recommended_shape: A floating workspace panel opened by toolbar and shortcut, with FieldMetadata rows, Inspect, Add chart, expandable quick inspection, and later axis drop.
success_moves: Share one inspector open path with the axis-label work

first_proof.question: Can a chart-only workspace open the list, find a field, inspect it, and add a chart without other layout changes?
first_proof.artifact: Demo with tables removed and the field list open
first_proof.decision_rule: Works by pointer and keyboard at three widths and opens without visible delay on the largest demo dataset.

fast_local_loop.command: focused component test; pnpm check:ui; browser check

milestones.outcome: Open-anywhere field list with search, Inspect, and Add chart
